I visited on a sunny day and the natural lights shining in were just amazing.

As for food, if I didn't remember wrong, most menu options they have are either drinks or desserts. The only menu option they serve other than cakes is hamburgers (I didn’t order it so I don’t know if it’s good or not). I had a banana & peach cake with a glass of honey lemonade. reviews.text: This is the best vegetarian/vegan/齋 buffet nearby NCCU and in my opinion the most student friendly I've encountered so far, within my five-years stay here.
